name: @argszero/dsh-image-price-fallback
description: Prices request images for the token meter on LLM routes whose adapter declares no image pricing. The harness only charges visual tokens when an adapter implements LlmAdapter.imageRequestPricing; the base class declares none, so every route served by an adapter that inherits it (the pi-ai adapter behind OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible gateways) has each retained image priced by the fixed structural heuristic — the JSON length of the image reference, a few dozen tokens — while the provider charges a thousand or more. The provider anchor repairs the session total on the steps it matches, but the per-node prices never are: those are what compaction reads to choose which span to summarize, so an image-heavy history looks cheap and is left in place. This plugin wraps ctx.llm.imageRequestPricing, calls the route's own answer first, and answers only when the route declares nothing and the model accepts images: a dimension-based estimate (default width×height/750, clamped) with published provenance and a configurable divisor. A route that declares its own pricing is never second-guessed; a route whose modality is unknown is left exactly as it is today.
